Main review v1 dependency source/manifest SHA plus v2 exact one-file hunk. Confirm common helper/header/CMake unchanged and no live worktree/old packet edit. Build free/contrib-llvm sourceLLVM7.1.1, mandatory lints and CPU regressions under existing owned lock. Check SYCL aligned_alloc_device/host APIs, device/host aspect and pointer identity consistency. No GPU CTest registration.
Actual tests Main sole finite owner: each of ten GU/Down NT cells fresh owned process with source/binary/provider pins, nativeinteger health and fault cursors before/after, no overlap/retry/reset. Confirm DEVICE allocations in receipt/actual pointer query, three completed checked initialization copies before exact event start, successful D2H event before every host output/reference check. Validate every group/output/tail sentinel, existing tolerance, shared bounds read only. Exercise allocation failure/size overflow helper behavior with CPU source fixtures if Main needs broader admission testing; malformed CLI before Runtime; faults never recast PASS. Inject copy/async failures only within Main safely owned fixture; ensure host vectors survive catch while drain and failed-drain failstop retains all state.
Capture individual kernel start/end/event durations, hostsubmit/kernelcompletion, H2D/D2H host intervals, wholecell, exact requested GPU/vector-capacity host bytes and all bounds/backend. Do not interpret H2D/D2H as physical DMA timings or divide to claim bus bandwidth. Separate firstlaunch/bundle overhead from repeated future endpoints. Real-model throughput/quality/roofline/productionqueue comparison separate future gates.
